LanguageData.CFB_Rec1: Needs a powered comms console in your colony.
LanguageData.CFB_Rec2: Allies cost 10 / 20 / 35 goodwill (small / medium / large), friendly factions half more.
LanguageData.CFB_Rec3: Each faction can be called once a day.
LanguageData.CFB_NeedConsole_Desc: Help can be called only with a powered comms console in one of your homes (also from caravans and other maps).
LanguageData.CFB_AllowFriends_Desc: Factions with goodwill 40 or more that are not allies can be called too, for half more goodwill.
LanguageData.CFB_Cooldown_Desc: In-game hours before the same faction can be called again.
LanguageData.CFB_CostSmall_Desc: Goodwill lost for small help (about half of the enemies' strength).
LanguageData.CFB_CostMedium_Desc: Goodwill lost for medium help (almost the enemies' strength).
LanguageData.CFB_CostLarge_Desc: Goodwill lost for large help (stronger than the enemies).
LanguageData.CFB_WalkDelay: Factions on foot arrive in: {0} h
LanguageData.CFB_WalkDelay_Desc: In-game hours until tribal and medieval allies march in (drop pods land at once).
LanguageData.CFB_ButtonDesc: Call an allied faction into this battle. Pick the faction and the size, then click where they should come.
LanguageData.CFB_NoConsole: Needs a powered comms console in your colony.
LanguageData.CFB_Wait: can be called again in {0} h
LanguageData.CFB_ThickRoof: Drop pods cannot land under a thick rock roof.
LanguageData.CFB_OnTheWay: {0} are on their way – they arrive in about {1} h.
